scripts.build: pnpm --filter @tami/shared build && pnpm run prisma:generate && nest build
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @tami/shared build && pnpm run prisma:generate && vitest run
scripts.test:integration: pnpm --filter @tami/shared build && pnpm run prisma:generate && vitest run src/auth/auth.integration.spec.ts src/bookings/prisma-booking.repository.integration.spec.ts
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @tami/shared build && pnpm run prisma:generate && tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit
